commands: ENDPOINT=$(aws ssm get-parameter --name /moodle/redis/endpoint --region $REGION --query Parameter.Value --output text 2>/dev/null || echo '')
if [ -z "$ENDPOINT" ]; then echo 'No Redis endpoint in SSM'; exit 2; fi
if grep -Eq '^[[:space:]]*\$CFG->session_handler_class[[:space:]]*=' /app/moodle/config.php; then echo 'SESSION_HANDLER_PRESENT'; else echo 'SESSION_HANDLER_MISSING'; fi
if grep -Fq "$ENDPOINT" /app/moodle/config.php; then echo 'HOST_PRESENT_IN_CONFIG'; else echo 'HOST_NOT_FOUND_IN_CONFIG'; fi
if command -v nc >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'NC_PRESENT'; else echo 'NC_MISSING'; fi
if command -v nc >/dev/null 2>&1 && nc -z -w2 "$ENDPOINT" 6379 >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'REDIS_CONNECT_OK(nc)'; else echo 'REDIS_CONNECT_FAIL(nc)'; fi

if command -v timeout >/dev/null 2>&1; then if timeout 2 bash -lc "</dev/tcp/$ENDPOINT/6379" >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'REDIS_CONNECT_OK(tcp)'; else echo 'REDIS_CONNECT_FAIL(tcp)'; fi; else echo 'TIMEOUT_NOT_FOUND'; fi
